concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's methodology explicitly requires a 'Baseline Comparison: Compare the 2D-only model performance against a theoretical baseline that assumes no 3D information is available, quantifying the performance gap (if any) attributable to the lack of conformational data.' The spec's only baseline (SC-001, US-2) is a null mean-predictor model, which does not quantify the gap attributable to missing 3D/conformational information. Add an FR/SC for this comparison or explicitly justify its absence.

Under-reach: the idea's expected results center on performance degradation 'for flexible or highly polarizable systems where 3D conformation is critical.' The spec mentions flexible molecules only as an Edge Case ('error analysis should highlight these specific outliers') with no corresponding FR or SC requiring a rigid-vs-flexible error analysis. Promote this to a requirement so the hypothesis is actually testable.

Corrupted leftover editing artifact: '...on the k-fold cross-validation The specific value to remove/generalize: 'k' Rewritten passage:.' This garbled text breaks the scenario statement; rewrite the scenario cleanly.

The idea's preprocessing sketch lists 'topological polar surface area' among the 2D descriptors; the spec excludes TPSA/TPSA_E as target-redundant proxies. Excluding a target-correlated feature is defensible methodological rigor, but the spec should briefly justify why TPSA (a 2D descriptor, not 3D leakage) is excluded, so the exclusion is not read as silently narrowing the idea's descriptor set.
